ask: One time, how much is too much for {name}?
hint: Over that, Vinnie has words. Way over, he comes through the glass. Not sure? Leave it: he'll start at {amount} and learn what's normal for you.
taken: You already have one of those. I keep records.
intro: One purchase over the line and he has words. Way over, he comes through the glass. Tap one to change it.
sourceLearned: Vinnie learned this from your receipts
